core_obligations: The odd-cycle proof derives uniform cycle-copy losses under bipartition imbalance and cross-edge deletion, then combines these with the second-order spectral expansion in distinct defect regimes. Explicit unbalanced bipartite star constructions give the sharp 1/sqrt(2) threshold for the entire odd-cycle family; the argument includes k-dependent embedding estimates, not just the shared triangle case.
